title: Debug: app crashes at startup — Hermes disabled in release
prompt: A release build crashes at startup with a Hermes-related native error (`com.facebook.jni.CppException: Failed to initialize Hermes VM`). The project upgraded to RN 0.74 but android/gradle.properties still has `hermesEnabled=false` from the old setup — RN 0.74 requires Hermes enabled (`hermesEnabled=true`) and the Babel hermes-strip-flow-types preset must be active in babel.config.js. Fix both files so Hermes is enabled and the preset is configured. Return each changed file with its complete new content.

fixtures.src/config/app.ts:
export const APP_NAME = 'rn-bench-app';
export const APP_VERSION = '1.0.0';
